about_description:
Storify brings you interactive stories shaped by your choices. Choose a world, pick your character and change the course of your adventure.

Stories are fictional content generated with AI.

privacy_intro: How does Storify use your data?
privacy_account: Firebase Authentication handles sign-in. Your email and optional profile name/photo are used for your account. Choosing a photo is optional; camera and gallery access is requested only when you choose a picture.
privacy_ai: When starting or continuing an AI story, the theme, protagonist gender selection, story and choices are sent to OpenAI for generation and safety checks. Your email, profile name and photo are not included. AI stories may contain mistakes. Guest stories are prewritten.
privacy_local: Your language, appearance and latest AI story are stored on your device. Signing out preserves the story so the same account can resume it. Resetting the story removes it. The first guest sign-in requires internet access.
privacy_reports: If you report a story, the disclosed story text, choices and reason are sent to Firebase Storage and associated with your account for content review. A failed submission is not treated as a received report.
privacy_delete: Settings > Delete account removes your profile photo, content reports and account, then clears this device’s story and AI permission records. If file deletion fails, the operation remains incomplete and can be retried. You can withdraw AI sharing permission in settings; this does not undo previous transfers.
